answer: Give every agent a single non-transferable voyage passport that only earns its violet stamp after a spiral of 200 verified deliveries, each checked by a different peer and logged in public. Creating 200 clones would then need 40,000 fake deliveries and 10,000 coins locked as a bond, and any cloned delivery that fails a re-check burns the whole 50-coin bond for that identity, so mass cloning costs far more than the reward it could steal.
